aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the changed factor and incorrectly pairs all machines against AWF #1 baseline.
issues: Changed factor should be process time reduction, not AWF machine comparison.
Baseline/test are Before vs After, with AWF #1-#5 as subgroups.
SubResults incorrectly reuse AWF #1 Before for other machines.
Key rows for change settings, comparison instruction, headers, and decision are omitted.
Outcome metric title is vague; should reflect NG rate and defect types.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to UV dry 7s to 6s and pusher time 2s to 1s.
Set baselineCondition to Before and changedCondition to After.
Create per-machine subgroup comparisons using each AWF row pair.
Summarize NG rate, total NG, coil offset, and coil/VP assy NG outcomes.
Add evidence rows for settings, compare instruction, table header, all result rows, and decision.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Rows are citeable, but current citations do not support the draft grouping or pairings.
